03 / READ & WRITE

The program is the parameters.

FORWARD PASSJavaScript
// No optimizer. No backpropagation.
const hidden = W.map((row, i) =>
  Math.max(0, dot(row, [x, y]) + b[i])
);

const probability = sigmoid(
  dot(v, hidden) + bias
);

THE IDEA BEHIND THE LAB

What if weights were
something we could write?

Weight-space programming asks whether a language model can inspect, repair, or construct a neural network directly through its parameters.

This lab is an independent educational illustration. Its small, hand-crafted classifier uses no LLM and does not reproduce the article’s experiments or benchmark results.
